title: 02 BATTERY CHARGING AND POWER PATH
purpose: BQ24074RGTR 1.5A USB-friendly LiPo battery charger and autonomous NVDC power-path manager. Powers VSYS directly from VBUS while charging the LiPo cell at 400mA, with dynamic power management (ILIM=1.5A), termination current at 40mA (ITERM=2k), and safety timer / thermal monitoring.

parts.role: 2-pad LiPo battery wire solder pads (BAT+ / BAT-)
10k pull-up on CHG_STAT status open-drain output
10k pull-up on PGOOD_N power-good open-drain output
10k pull-down on CHG_EN for default charging enabled
1.2k resistor on ILIM pin setting input current limit to 1.3A
2.0k resistor on ISET pin setting charge current to 400mA
2.0k resistor on ITERM pin setting termination current to 40mA
47k resistor on TMR pin setting fast-charge safety timer to 6.2 hours
10uF bypass capacitor on BQ24074 IN (VBUS) pin
10uF output capacitor on VSYS power-path output

qa.formula: I_CHG = K_ISET / R_ISET, K_ISET = 800 A*Ohm (BQ24074 Datasheet Section 9.3.7.2)
qa.result: R_ISET = 2.0 kOhm -> I_CHG = 800 / 2000 = 0.400 A (400 mA). Perfectly sized for typical 1S wearable LiPo cells (350-600 mAh at ~0.8C-1C rate).
qa.source: Texas Instruments BQ24074 Datasheet SLUS884F Section 9.3.7.2

qa.formula: I_IN_MAX = K_ILIM / R_ILIM, K_ILIM = 1550 A*Ohm (BQ24074 Section 9.3.7.1)
qa.result: R_ILIM = 1.2 kOhm -> I_IN_MAX = 1550 / 1200 = 1.29 A (~1.3 A). Safely supports 400 mA charging + 500 mA system peak load under USB Type-C 1.5A supply.
qa.source: Texas Instruments BQ24074 Datasheet SLUS884F Section 9.3.7.1

qa.result: R_ITERM = 2.0 kOhm -> I_TERM = 0.1 * I_CHG = 40 mA. Standard 10% termination ensures complete saturation of LiPo without over-soaking.
qa.source: Texas Instruments BQ24074 Datasheet SLUS884F Section 9.3.7.3

qa.result: R_TMR = 47 kOhm -> t_MAX = 0.133 * 47 = 6.25 hours fast-charge limit. Ample time for full CC-CV charging while preventing thermal runaway on defective cells.
qa.source: Texas Instruments BQ24074 Datasheet SLUS884F Section 9.3.7.4
